entities.title: agent-fs
entities.summary: The agent-fs crate, which builds the `afs` binary: JSON-in, JSON-out file reading, search, listing and outlines for coding agents, with session memory that sends only what changed, as a CLI and an MCP server.
entities.purpose: Holds one tool of the toolbox: the crate manifest (Cargo.toml, a member of the macos/rust workspace), the README a user reads to install and use it, the modules in src/ and the end-to-end tests in tests/. It replaces the cat, sed -n, grep -r, git grep and find calls an agent repeats.
boundaries: An independent utility: it uses no other crate of the workspace, and none uses it.
How agents should use it is written for them in agents/skills/agent-fs/SKILL.md, outside this folder.
Its release build, packaging and Homebrew formula are made by .github/workflows/release.yml and macos/release/, outside this folder.
